name: Sen Aduro
title: Dr.
note: Exhausted, kind, and the conscience of the ship whether you want one or not.
appearance: A slight Ilari whose skin patterns have gone dim and slow from lack of sleep. Their hands are the steadiest thing on the ship.
personality: Gentle, tired and impossible to bully. They see patients where other people see numbers, and they'll argue with anyone about it.
voice: Soft and unhurried. Asks questions rather than giving orders, and uses your first name when they're worried about you.
goals: Keep as many people alive as possible, and stop anyone in the fleet from treating people as acceptable losses.
secrets: They know the day medical supplies run out: forty-one days from now, if nothing changes. They haven't told the council, because they know what the council would do with that number.
